dvālopika.p: [Dvālopa+ṇika] (ti) CL=8 has two full mouth, it is enough two full mouth, who has eaten only two full mouth; he. Dvāgārika - see.

B:
dvālopika：dvālopika（ti）
ဒွါလောပိက（တိ）
[dvālopa+ṇika]
[ဒွါလောပ+ဏိက]
K:
dvālopika：ဒွါလောပိက（တိ）
[ဒွါလောပ+ဏိက]
၂-လုတ်ရှိသော၊ ၂-လုတ်ဖြင့်-ဖြစ်-မျှတ-သော၊ ၂-လုတ်သာ စားသော၊ သူ။ ဒွါဂါရိက-ကြည့်။
DOP: dvālopika mfn. [ from dvi + ālopa], living on only two portions of alms ; D I 166, 11 (so ekāgāriko hoti ekālopiko dvāgāriko vā hoti ~o); M I 238, 23 (~ā).
NCP: mfn. | dvaalopika living on only two portions of alms.
